book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第一册
unit_cn: Unit 2 Onwards and Upwards 勇往直前
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 2 词表(p13-23 真词);IPA 英音标准词典回填;例句原创、坚持/成功/勇往直前主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Before her success, the young writer was deep in debt.
words.example_cn: 在成功之前,这位年轻作家负债累累。

words.example_en: She wrote at a steady pace and finished the novel within a year.
words.example_cn: 她以稳定的进度写作,一年内完成了这部小说。

words.example_en: "We regret to inform you that your work has not been chosen."
words.example_cn: “我们遗憾地通知您,您的作品未被选中。”

words.example_en: Every writer dreads receiving a letter of rejection.
words.example_cn: 每位作家都害怕收到拒稿信。

words.example_en: Everyone knows that success rarely happens overnight.
words.example_cn: 人人都知道成功很少会一蹴而就。

words.example_en: Nobody becomes a great writer overnight.
words.example_cn: 没有人能一夜之间成为伟大的作家。

words.example_en: She faced twelve rejections before her book was finally printed.
words.example_cn: 在书最终付印之前,她遭遇了十二次拒绝。

words.example_en: The work was hard; nevertheless, she persevered.
words.example_cn: 工作很艰难;然而,她坚持了下来。

words.example_en: If you persevere, you will reach your goal in the end.
words.example_cn: 只要坚持不懈,你终将实现目标。

words.example_en: Great writers often face criticism along with rejection.
words.example_cn: 伟大的作家常常既遭拒绝又受批评。

words.example_en: He carried the manuscript of his novel everywhere he went.
words.example_cn: 他走到哪里都带着小说的手稿。

words.example_en: When it was finally published, the book became a best-seller.
words.example_cn: 当它最终出版时,这本书成了畅销书。

words.example_en: Today these novels are regarded as classics of world literature.
words.example_cn: 如今这些小说被视为世界文学的经典。

words.example_en: Writing a long book takes great endurance.
words.example_cn: 写一本长篇巨著需要极大的耐力。

words.example_en: Talent alone cannot guarantee success.
words.example_cn: 仅有天赋并不能保证成功。

words.example_en: "We are delighted to inform you that you have won."
words.example_cn: “我们高兴地通知您,您获奖了。”

words.example_en: After years of effort, the outcome was finally a success.
words.example_cn: 经过多年努力,结果终于是成功的。

words.example_en: Even with its challenges, the experience felt worthwhile.
words.example_cn: 尽管有种种挑战,这段经历仍让人觉得值得。

words.example_en: A person who spoils everyone's fun is called a wet blanket.
words.example_cn: 扫大家兴的人被称作“扫兴鬼”。

words.example_en: She stayed enthusiastic even when things went wrong.
words.example_cn: 即使事情出了差错,她依然保持热情。

words.example_en: He felt sad because he had failed in a writing contest.
words.example_cn: 他很难过,因为在写作比赛中失利了。

words.example_en: Don't be too upset; you really did your best.
words.example_cn: 别太难过,你确实尽力了。

words.example_en: She ran for class leader but was not elected.
words.example_cn: 她竞选班长,但没有当选。

words.example_en: A few days of silence can be a real blessing.
words.example_cn: 几天的安静有时是一种真正的福气。

words.example_en: Darkness can make us more appreciative of light.
words.example_cn: 黑暗能让我们更懂得珍惜光明。

words.example_en: Her endless effort made her worthy of the prize.
words.example_cn: 她不懈的努力使她配得上这个奖。

words.example_en: Through the mere touch of her fingers she found great beauty.
words.example_cn: 仅凭手指的触摸,她就发现了极大的美。

words.example_en: She still remembers the gentleness of her teacher's words.
words.example_cn: 她仍记得老师话语中的温和。

words.example_en: The companionship of good friends makes life worth living.
words.example_cn: 好友的陪伴让生活值得过。

words.example_en: She could read the shape of a face with her fingertips.
words.example_cn: 她能用指尖读出一张脸的轮廓。

words.example_en: In the dark he could feel only the outline of the room.
words.example_cn: 在黑暗中他只能摸到房间的轮廓。

words.example_en: In the museum she wanted to probe the story of human progress.
words.example_cn: 在博物馆里,她想探究人类进步的故事。

words.example_en: Each morning he greeted the dawn with new hope.
words.example_cn: 每天清晨,他都以新的希望迎接黎明。

words.example_en: Discovering new beauty was a real delight to her.
words.example_cn: 发现新的美对她来说是一件真正的乐事。

words.example_en: Each new day brought fresh revelations of beauty.
words.example_cn: 每一个新的日子都带来美的新展现。

words.example_en: He kept writing amid criticism and rejection.
words.example_cn: 在批评与拒绝之中,他坚持写作。

words.example_en: At midnight, permanent darkness would close in again.
words.example_cn: 午夜时分,永久的黑暗会再次袭来。

words.example_en: Only when night descended did she realise how much she had missed.
words.example_cn: 直到夜幕降临,她才意识到自己错过了多少。

words.example_en: Hear the mighty music of an orchestra while you still can.
words.example_cn: 趁还能听,去听管弦乐队雄壮的乐声吧。

words.example_en: The mighty sound of the orchestra filled the whole hall.
words.example_cn: 管弦乐队雄壮的乐声充满了整个大厅。

words.example_en: Smell the perfume of flowers as if for the last time.
words.example_cn: 像是最后一次那样,去闻花的芳香。

words.example_en: She tasted each small meal with great relish.
words.example_cn: 她津津有味地品尝每一顿简单的饭菜。

words.meaning_cn: 令人愉快的;讨人喜欢的
words.example_en: Of all the senses, sight may be the most delightful.
words.example_cn: 在所有感官中,视觉也许是最令人愉快的。

words.example_en: Their novels are now seen as great literary works.
words.example_cn: 他们的小说如今被视为伟大的文学作品。

words.example_en: He felt embarrassed when he spilled the soup in the dark.
words.example_cn: 在黑暗中打翻汤时,他感到很尴尬。

words.example_en: An eager beaver is someone who loves to work very hard.
words.example_cn: “拼命三郎”指特别热衷于努力工作的人。

words.example_en: He stayed as cool as a cucumber during the difficult contest.
words.example_cn: 在艰难的比赛中,他始终镇定自若。

words.example_en: The old library was a favourite haunt of the young writer.
words.example_cn: 那座旧图书馆是这位年轻作家常去的地方。
